# Data Preparation

## Import Library dan Dataset

Pada tahap awal, dilakukan import library yang dibutuhkan untuk proses pengolahan data dan visualisasi. Dataset customer churn diperoleh dari repositori GitHub.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)
```

```{r}
# Import data dari GitHub
customer_churn <- read.csv(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Muhammadrizkybagas/bookdown-template/refs/heads/main/data/customer_churn.csv"
)

# Melihat data
head(customer_churn)
```

## Data Cleaning

Proses cleaning dilakukan untuk memastikan data memiliki format yang sesuai sebelum dianalisis.

```{r}
customer_churn <- customer_churn %>%
  mutate(
    across(where(is.character), trimws),
    signup_date = as.Date(signup_date),
    region = as.factor(region),
    segment = as.factor(segment),
    contract_type = as.factor(contract_type),
    payment_method = as.factor(payment_method),
    internet_service = as.factor(internet_service),
    churn = factor(churn, levels = c(0, 1),
                   labels = c("Tidak Churn", "Churn"))
  ) %>%
  distinct(customer_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

## Pemeriksaan Data

```{r}
# Struktur data
str(customer_churn)

# Dimensi data
dim(customer_churn)

# Missing value setiap kolom
colSums(is.na(customer_churn))

# Total missing value
sum(is.na(customer_churn))

# Duplikasi ID pelanggan
sum(duplicated(customer_churn$customer_id))

# Statistik deskriptif
summary(customer_churn)
```

## Persiapan Variabel Analisis

Membuat variabel numerik churn untuk kebutuhan perhitungan tingkat churn dan korelasi.

```{r}
customer_churn <- customer_churn %>%
  mutate(
    churn_num = as.integer(churn == "Churn")
  )
```

# Overview Dataset

Bagian ini memberikan gambaran umum mengenai karakteristik dataset dan kondisi pelanggan.

## Informasi Dataset

```{r}
cat("Jumlah Pelanggan:", nrow(customer_churn), "\n")
cat("Jumlah Variabel:", ncol(customer_churn), "\n")
cat("Tanggal Pendaftaran Terawal:", min(customer_churn$signup_date), "\n")
cat("Tanggal Pendaftaran Terakhir:", max(customer_churn$signup_date), "\n")
cat("Total Missing Value:", sum(is.na(customer_churn)), "\n")
```

## Key Performance Indicators (KPI)

```{r}
total_customer <- nrow(customer_churn)

total_churn <- sum(customer_churn$churn == "Churn")

total_stay <- sum(customer_churn$churn == "Tidak Churn")

churn_rate <- total_churn / total_customer

stay_rate <- total_stay / total_customer

kpi <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Total Customer",
    "Customer Churn",
    "Customer Retained",
    "Churn Rate",
    "Retention Rate"
  ),
  Value = c(
    total_customer,
    total_churn,
    total_stay,
    percent(churn_rate),
    percent(stay_rate)
  )
)

knitr::kable(kpi, caption = "Customer Overview")
```

## Distribusi Status Pelanggan

Visualisasi ini digunakan untuk mengetahui perbandingan pelanggan yang masih berlangganan dan pelanggan yang berhenti berlangganan.

```{r}
ggplot(customer_churn, aes(x = churn, fill = churn)) +
  geom_bar(width = 0.65) +
  geom_text(
    stat = "count",
    aes(label = after_stat(count)),
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Tidak Churn" = "#2E86AB",
               "Churn" = "#E76F51")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribusi Status Pelanggan",
    subtitle = "Perbandingan pelanggan churn dan tidak churn",
    x = "Status Pelanggan",
    y = "Jumlah Pelanggan"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## Proporsi Status Pelanggan

```{r}
churn_distribution <- customer_churn %>%
  count(churn) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = n / sum(n),
    label = paste0(
      churn, "\n",
      percent(percentage, accuracy = 0.1)
    )
  )

ggplot(churn_distribution,
       aes(x = "", y = percentage, fill = churn)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "white",
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Tidak Churn" = "#2E86AB",
               "Churn" = "#E76F51")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Proporsi Pelanggan Churn",
    fill = "Status"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```

# Customer Demographics and Segmentation

Bagian ini menganalisis karakteristik pelanggan berdasarkan wilayah dan jenis segmen pelanggan.

## Distribusi Pelanggan Berdasarkan Wilayah

```{r}
ggplot(customer_churn, aes(x = region, fill = region)) +
  geom_bar() +
  geom_text(
    stat = "count",
    aes(label = after_stat(count)),
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribusi Pelanggan Berdasarkan Wilayah",
    x = "Wilayah",
    y = "Jumlah Pelanggan"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)
  )
```

## Distribusi Pelanggan Berdasarkan Segmen

```{r}
ggplot(customer_churn, aes(x = segment, fill = segment)) +
  geom_bar() +
  geom_text(
    stat = "count",
    aes(label = after_stat(count)),
    vjust = -0.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribusi Pelanggan Berdasarkan Segmen",
    x = "Segmen Pelanggan",
    y = "Jumlah Pelanggan"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## Perbandingan Churn Berdasarkan Wilayah

```{r}
ggplot(customer_churn, aes(x = region, fill = churn)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "Jumlah Churn Berdasarkan Wilayah",
    x = "Wilayah",
    y = "Jumlah Pelanggan",
    fill = "Status Churn"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```

## Tingkat Churn Berdasarkan Wilayah

Jumlah churn saja belum cukup untuk membandingkan wilayah karena setiap wilayah memiliki jumlah pelanggan yang berbeda. Oleh karena itu, digunakan churn rate.

```{r}
region_churn <- customer_churn %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarise(
    total_customer = n(),
    total_churn = sum(churn == "Churn"),
    churn_rate = total_churn / total_customer,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(region_churn,
       aes(x = reorder(region, churn_rate),
           y = churn_rate,
           fill = churn_rate)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = percent(churn_rate, accuracy = 0.1)),
    hjust = -0.2
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Churn Rate Berdasarkan Wilayah",
    x = "Wilayah",
    y = "Churn Rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## Tingkat Churn Berdasarkan Segmen

```{r}
segment_churn <- customer_churn %>%
  group_by(segment) %>%
  summarise(
    total_customer = n(),
    total_churn = sum(churn == "Churn"),
    churn_rate = total_churn / total_customer,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(segment_churn,
       aes(x = reorder(segment, churn_rate),
           y = churn_rate,
           fill = segment)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = percent(churn_rate, accuracy = 0.1)),
    vjust = -0.5
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent,
    limits = c(0, 0.55)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Churn Rate Berdasarkan Segmen Pelanggan",
    x = "Segmen",
    y = "Churn Rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# Customer Registration Trend

Bagian ini menganalisis perkembangan jumlah pelanggan berdasarkan tanggal pendaftaran.

## Tren Pendaftaran Pelanggan

```{r}
monthly_signup <- customer_churn %>%
  mutate(
    month = as.Date(format(signup_date, "%Y-%m-01"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(
    total_customer = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(monthly_signup,
       aes(x = month, y = total_customer)) +
  geom_line(color = "#2E86AB", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#E76F51", size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Tren Pendaftaran Pelanggan per Bulan",
    x = "Bulan",
    y = "Jumlah Pelanggan"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Tren Churn Berdasarkan Bulan Pendaftaran

Visualisasi ini melihat persentase pelanggan yang mengalami churn berdasarkan bulan ketika mereka mendaftar.

```{r}
monthly_churn <- customer_churn %>%
  mutate(
    month = as.Date(format(signup_date, "%Y-%m-01"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(
    total_customer = n(),
    total_churn = sum(churn == "Churn"),
    churn_rate = total_churn / total_customer,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(monthly_churn,
       aes(x = month, y = churn_rate)) +
  geom_line(color = "#E76F51", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#2E86AB", size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Churn Rate Berdasarkan Bulan Pendaftaran",
    x = "Bulan Pendaftaran",
    y = "Churn Rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Customer Tenure Analysis

Tenure merupakan lama waktu pelanggan telah berlangganan dalam satuan bulan.

## Distribusi Tenure Pelanggan

```{r}
ggplot(customer_churn,
       aes(x = tenure_months)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 30,
    fill = "#2E86AB",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribusi Lama Berlangganan Pelanggan",
    x = "Tenure (Bulan)",
    y = "Frekuensi"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Distribusi Tenure Berdasarkan Status Churn

```{r}
ggplot(customer_churn,
       aes(x = tenure_months, fill = churn)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribusi Tenure Berdasarkan Status Churn",
    x = "Tenure (Bulan)",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Perbandingan Tenure dengan Boxplot

```{r}
ggplot(customer_churn,
       aes(x = churn, y = tenure_months, fill = churn)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Perbandingan Tenure Berdasarkan Status Churn",
    x = "Status Pelanggan",
    y = "Tenure (Bulan)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## Churn Rate Berdasarkan Kelompok Tenure

```{r}
tenure_churn <- customer_churn %>%
  mutate(
    tenure_group = cut(
      tenure_months,
      breaks = c(0, 12, 24, 36, 48, 60, Inf),
      labels = c(
        "0-12 Bulan",
        "13-24 Bulan",
        "25-36 Bulan",
        "37-48 Bulan",
        "49-60 Bulan",
        ">60 Bulan"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(tenure_group) %>%
  summarise(
    total_customer = n(),
    total_churn = sum(churn == "Churn"),
    churn_rate = total_churn / total_customer,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(tenure_churn,
       aes(x = tenure_group, y = churn_rate, fill = tenure_group)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = percent(churn_rate, accuracy = 0.1)),
    vjust = -0.5
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Churn Rate Berdasarkan Kelompok Tenure",
    x = "Kelompok Tenure",
    y = "Churn Rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1)
  )
```

```{r}
    title = "Support Calls Berdasarkan Status Churn",
    x = "Status Pelanggan",
    y = "Jumlah Support Calls"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## Churn Rate Berdasarkan Support Calls

```{r}
support_churn <- customer_churn %>%

  )

ggplot(support_churn,
```

## Korelasi Antarvariabel Numerik

```{r}
numeric_data <- customer_churn %>%
  select(
    tenure_months,
    monthly_charges,
    total_charges,
    num_complaints,
    support_calls,
    churn_num
  )

correlation_matrix <- cor(
  numeric_data,
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)

correlation_data <- as.data.frame(
  as.table(correlation_matrix)
)

ggplot(
  correlation_data,
  aes(x = Var1, y = Var2, fill = Freq)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = round(Freq, 2)),
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#E76F51",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#2E86AB",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-1, 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Correlation Heatmap Antarvariabel",
    x = "",
    y = "",
    fill = "Korelasi"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )
```

# Summary and Business Insights

## Ringkasan Churn Berdasarkan Variabel Kategorikal

Tabel berikut digunakan untuk membandingkan churn rate pada setiap kategori.

```{r}
categorical_summary <- bind_rows(
  customer_churn %>%
    group_by(region) %>%
    summarise(
      variable = "Region",
      category = as.character(first(region)),
      total_customer = n(),
      total_churn = sum(churn == "Churn"),
      churn_rate = total_churn / total_customer,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    select(variable, category, total_customer, total_churn, churn_rate),

  customer_churn %>%
    group_by(segment) %>%
    summarise(
      variable = "Segment",
      category = as.character(first(segment)),
      total_customer = n(),
      total_churn = sum(churn == "Churn"),
      churn_rate = total_churn / total_customer,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    select(variable, category, total_customer, total_churn, churn_rate),

  customer_churn %>%
    group_by(contract_type) %>%
    summarise(
      variable = "Contract",
      category = as.character(first(contract_type)),
      total_customer = n(),
      total_churn = sum(churn == "Churn"),
      churn_rate = total_churn / total_customer,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    select(variable, category, total_customer, total_churn, churn_rate),

  customer_churn %>%
    group_by(payment_method) %>%
    summarise(
      variable = "Payment Method",
      category = as.character(first(payment_method)),
      total_customer = n(),
      total_churn = sum(churn == "Churn"),
      churn_rate = total_churn / total_customer,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    select(variable, category, total_customer, total_churn, churn_rate),

  customer_churn %>%
    group_by(internet_service) %>%
    summarise(
      variable = "Internet Service",
      category = as.character(first(internet_service)),
      total_customer = n(),
      total_churn = sum(churn == "Churn"),
      churn_rate = total_churn / total_customer,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    select(variable, category, total_customer, total_churn, churn_rate)
)

categorical_summary %>%
  arrange(desc(churn_rate)) %>%
  mutate(churn_rate = percent(churn_rate, accuracy = 0.1)) %>%
  knitr::kable(
    caption = "Churn Rate Berdasarkan Kategori Pelanggan"
  )
```

## Faktor dengan Churn Rate Tertinggi

```{r}
categorical_summary %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  slice_max(
    order_by = churn_rate,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    churn_rate = percent(churn_rate, accuracy = 0.1)
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(
    caption = "Kategori dengan Churn Rate Tertinggi pada Setiap Variabel"
  )
```

## Rangkuman Statistik Numerik Berdasarkan Churn

```{r}
customer_churn %>%
  group_by(churn) %>%
  summarise(
    total_customer = n(),
    avg_tenure = mean(tenure_months),
    avg_monthly_charges = mean(monthly_charges),
    avg_total_charges = mean(total_charges, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_complaints = mean(num_complaints),
    avg_support_calls = mean(support_calls),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(
    digits = 2,
    caption = "Rata-rata Karakteristik Pelanggan Berdasarkan Status Churn"
  )
```

## Kesimpulan dan Insight

Berdasarkan seluruh proses Exploratory Data Analysis, beberapa aspek yang perlu diperhatikan adalah:

1. **Customer Churn:** Mengidentifikasi proporsi pelanggan yang berhenti berlangganan dibandingkan pelanggan yang masih aktif.

2. **Customer Segmentation:** Mengetahui wilayah dan segmen pelanggan yang memiliki tingkat churn relatif tinggi.

3. **Contract Type:** Membandingkan tingkat churn berdasarkan jenis kontrak untuk melihat apakah pelanggan dengan kontrak bulanan memiliki kecenderungan churn yang berbeda dari kontrak jangka panjang.

4. **Customer Tenure:** Menganalisis hubungan antara lama berlangganan dengan status churn, khususnya apakah pelanggan dengan masa berlangganan lebih singkat menunjukkan tingkat churn lebih tinggi.

5. **Financial Analysis:** Mengidentifikasi perbedaan biaya bulanan dan total biaya antara pelanggan yang churn dan tidak churn.

6. **Customer Experience:** Menganalisis apakah jumlah keluhan dan panggilan customer support memiliki pola hubungan dengan churn.

7. **Customer Behavior:** Menggabungkan beberapa variabel untuk menemukan kelompok pelanggan yang perlu mendapatkan perhatian lebih.

Hasil EDA ini dapat digunakan sebagai dasar untuk menentukan variabel yang akan dianalisis lebih lanjut dalam tahap pemodelan Machine Learning, khususnya prediksi Customer Churn.

Perlu diperhatikan bahwa hubungan antarvariabel dalam EDA tidak secara otomatis menunjukkan hubungan sebab-akibat. Analisis lanjutan diperlukan untuk menguji temuan tersebut.
